deadline.value: International applicants should apply by January 15 for admission and support; teaching assistantship priority also runs to January 15.
deadline.quote: International applications for admission and support (15 January)

gre_subject.value: GRE general and subject scores are not required to apply.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores (general and subject) are not required for students submitting an application.

supervisor.value: Students do not need a research adviser before applying; they secure one after starting.
supervisor.quote: Students do not secure a research advisor until after they start our program

funding.value: Financial support is typically provided to students admitted to the doctoral program.
funding.quote: financial support is typically provided for students who apply to our doctoral program

entry_route.value: Applicants can apply straight from undergraduate study; a master's is not needed.
entry_route.quote: You can apply to our program directly from your undergraduate studies, you do not need to have a master's degree to apply to our Ph.D. program.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required to apply.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores (general and subject) are not required for students submitting an application.

fee_waiver.value: The department has no application fee waiver program.
fee_waiver.quote: We do not have an application fee waiver program.
